content:
The latest macOS 26.7 beta version appears to have leaked extensive information about several upcoming Apple home products, including a new-generation HomePod mini, a security camera, a new Siri Remote for use with the new Apple TV 4K, as well as the much-anticipated HomePad device.

After in-depth analysis of the code, important clues about the design direction of the HomePad have also been uncovered...

Filipe Espósito of Engadget discovered that, although the HomePad is highly likely to run some version of tvOS, its operation method may be closer to that of an enlarged Apple Watch.

The code also reveals a rather thoughtful privacy feature: the HomePad will only display your personal information on widgets when it detects that your iPhone is nearby.

We expect the HomePad to be released in two versions — one equipped with a HomePod-like speaker base, and the other designed for wall-mounted installation.

Besides the other Apple home products I mentioned earlier, other unknown devices have also been mentioned. Personally, I'm really hoping one of them is a smart doorbell. Are there any particular Apple home products you are looking forward to? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
